tei:div.tei:p: 283) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: zab chos spyi la gces pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dmigs rim dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: 284)na mo padma kā ra ye: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud: rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa'i dbus: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor la brten nas: tshe 'dir don gnyis spyod 'dod pa'i: don du dmigs rim 'di ltar bstan: ma nor tshul bzhin sus spyod pa: don gyi rnal 'byor 'byung bar nges: sa ma ya: de la dang po las gzhung ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa rnams ji bzhin par gsal btab pa gal che'o: de nas dang po bsnyen pa'i thugs srog gang yin kyang de'i gdong sngon la gtad cing rnam bcad rgyab tu yod pa thabs shes nyi zla'i gwa'u'i nang du thugs srog spu shad kyis 285)bris pa lta bur 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par gsal gdab: de'i mtha' skor du rtsa ba'i sngags rnams thabs la g.yon bkod dang shes rab la g.yas bkod du bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang: khyad par rigs bdag bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshim nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa dag: thugs rje'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par rang gi sgo gsum la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum 286)gyi sgrib pa thams skad cig la dag nas sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs par bsam la thugs srog kho nar 'dun pa gtad nas bsnyen pa kho nar brtson par bya'o: de nas nye bsnyen gyi skabs su sngar gyi sngags phreng rnams gdan las 'phags te srog yig gi sked nas pho la g.yas dang mo la g.yon du kyi li li 'khor ba las thugs srog dang sngags 'khor rnams las 'od zer mchod 'dzin gyi lha mo dang bcas pa 'phros pas:

phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: thugs bde stong gi ros tshim nas mthu stobs nus pa dbang byin dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs: thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pas mchog dang thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam pa dang: khyad par thugs srog las 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i ro dang ldan pa 'phros: rigs bdag gi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas rang gzhan rnams kyi las sgrib bag chags thams cad dag nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar gyi rnam par byung nas rang gi gnas lngar thim pas sgrib pa bzhi 287)dag: dbang bzhi thob: sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du gyur par bsam la sngar ltar thugs srog dang sngags 'khor la ma yengs par brtson par bya'o: de nas sgrub pa'i dus su sngags phreng rnams gdan la babs nas me las me stag mched pa bzhin sngags 'khor las sngags phreng gnyis pa re 'od zer gyi drwa bas sbrel bar 'phros te hrīḥyig gi rkang pa dang hūm̐ yig gi zhabs kyu nas brgyud de rang gi zhal nas mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de gsang ba nas thon: rang gi gsang bar zhugs: thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par bsam pa dang: de las 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes yon tan thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byung nas rang gi sgo gsum dang dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas rnams dang gnyis su med par thim pas: sgo gsum dag rdzogs smin gsum mthar phyin nas mchog gi rig 'dzin go 'phang thob par bsam mo: de nas sgrub pa chen po'i dus su rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed lha'i thugs rgyud bskul:

de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan yar 'phros 288)pas phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs kyi rgyal ba rnams la sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshim: thugs rje byin rlabs ye shes yon tan thams cad sku phyag rgya: gsung yig 'bru: thugs phyag mtshan: yon tan phrin las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyi rnam par byung nas bdag mdun dang dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad gcig char du thob pa dang: 'od zer mar 'phros khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi gnas dang yul gyi bag chags thams cad sbyangs nas phyi snod rgyal ba'i zhing khams dang nang bcud kyi skye 'gro thams cad yi dam lha'i rang bzhin dang: sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra: dran rtog 'gyu dran gyi rtog pa thams cad bde chen thugs kyi rol par sad nas: snang grags rig pa lha sngags chos nyid chen por 'byams klas par bsam: rang gi rtsa khams thams cad gzhal yas khang dang: khams dkar dmar dpa' bo dang dpa' mo: rlung phyir 'phros pa dang ma 'phros pa thams cad sngags kyi rang bzhin dang: dran rtog thams cad 'od gsal chos nyid kyi rol par dag nas: snang srid thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur nas thams cad kyis sngags kyi sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar di ri ri sgrogs par bsam pa'o: 289)de nas las sbyor gyi dmigs rim ni: snga dro'i dus bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung nas bdag mdun la thim pas zhi ba'i mthu dang yon tan thams cad thob par bsam: 'od zer mar 'phros pas khams gsum rigs drug gi las nyon bag chags thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sbyangs shing: sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal rnams dag nas thams cad ye shes lha'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo:

nyin phyed dus bdag mdun gyi thugs las 'od zer ser po mchod 'dzin gyi lha mo dang bcas pa 'phros: rgyal ba rnams la mchod pa phul nas thugs rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad dang: lha dang drang srong snang srid snod bcud la sogs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'od zer ser po'i rnam par dag mdun la thim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel bar bsam mo: dgung mo'i dus bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas thugs bde 290)stong gi ros tshims: thugs rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad dang: rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad 'od dmar gyi rnam par zhu nas bdag mdun la thim par bsam: 'od zer mar 'phros pas lha klu mi gsum la sogs pa skye dgu'i bdag po thams cad dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol: tshe bsod nams dpal 'byor zas nor longs spyod chos srid mnga' thang la sogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus par bsam mo: nub dus bdag mdun gyi thugs las 'od zer thun mtshon khro chung me dpung gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros nas nyon mongs dug lnga dug gsum las bskyed pa'i gzugs can gzugs med kyi gnod byed thams cad thun gyis brabs: me dpung gis bsregs: spu gri'i gtor nas rjes shul tsam yang med par bsam pa dang: rnam shes 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su spar nas sangs rgyas par bsam mo: des mde'u la me 'u btags pa bzhin du phrin las thams cad ngang gis 'grub par 'gyur ro: khyad par gsal ba lha'i gzer: dgongs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gzer: bzlas pa sngags kyi gzer: phrin las 'phro 'du'i gzer rnams ni shin ru gal che ba yin pas shes par bya'o: de ltar 291)rim gnyis lam mchog sgrub pa'i thabs// 'phro 'du'i dmigs rim dngos grub snye ma 'di// dad ldan skyes bu dge btsun 'dul 'dzin pa// bya bral bsam gtan nyid kyis yang yang du// dbang mdog lha reg dang bcas bskul pa'i ngor// gsang lung dben khrod rang byung mkha' 'gro'i gnas// skyon bral yon tan 'phel ba'i dga' tshal du// kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos bris pa'o//
